decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 200342-48-DR-001, 200342-48-DR-002, 200342-48-DR-003, 200342-48-DR-004, 200342-48-DR-005, 200342-48-DR-006, 200342-48-DR-007, Environmental Statement, Non Technical Summary, and Planning Design and Access Statement received 13th May 2010 and further information on the CCHP received 31st August 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The Local Planning Authority shall be provided with details of the method statement(s) for the works which will include potential contaminants of concern, how excavations will be inspected; and what will be done if potential contamination is encountered.  The Local Planning Authority shall be notified if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development and methods to remediate the identified contamination shall be provided to the Local Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of the development continues. Details of the strategy for validation for imported soils shall be forwarded to the Local Authority for approval.  This strategy shall include details of the source of material, testing frequency and import criteria values. Before the development is first brought into use a validation (closure) report shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval following completion of all works on site.  The report shall include details of any remedial works undertaken for additional contamination if encountered during the development.
description: Erection of a combined cooling and heating power plant
